label: resided in
definition: Person or population 1 resides or formerly resided in geographic place 2.
scope_notes: Live/resident/residence and explicit resettlement qualify. Visiting, travel, work, officeholding and citizenship alone do not establish residence.

facts.reason: Cubans explicitly live in United States, but Mexicans traveling there share the same inferred entity pair. The population identity is mixed and cannot be resolved from this case.
facts.reviewer_question: Does this inferred population denote Cubans or Mexicans, and which group is the residence fact intended to identify?
